QUOTE: Cancel poller threads ... "Each one spins at 10 ms, reads an int or atomic, and sets an atomic `cancel_` flag." and "The C ABI passes only `int*`, so no `std::atomic` crosses the `.so` boundary."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the cancel pollers read an int and set an atomic flag, and that the C ABI carries only `int*`, so no atomic can cross. That is the bridging purpose the item asks for.
